posts.name: The Blue-Eyed Bard
posts.cooked:
Alright! We have four official submissions for the part of Equity and one additional, special submission that involved one intrepid aspirant trying their hand at both parts!

I’ve anonymized the submissions and gathered them here:

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11yhyUHeyZtYOgdZVzo9gnZ1Sx9pZqWll?usp=sharing

And boy howdy, am I sick of my own voice!

So, anyone who would like to contribute to the democratic process of electing our new Equity should feel free to listen to the lot of these and let us know their favorite.

Feedback is not only welcome, it’s strongly encouraged. Everyone involved in the submission process has an interest in this sort of thing and would, if they’re anything like me, appreciate constructive feedback regarding their performances. What you liked, what you didn’t like, what you thought could be improved, what you thought was done perfectly…anything and everything. We want to do this, but we want to do it as well as we can, and continually raise the bar as we go. That includes my amateur-at-best audio editing.

I’ve got a few thoughts on roles, especially regarding the special submission, but will keep them to myself for now. I want your thoughts at this point.

Voting will go through the week, concluding on the 24th. Even with the holiday, that should give folks plenty of time to listen to a handful of two-to-three-minute sound clips and share their thoughts on them.

And, by this time next week, we’ll have our Equity.

I believe I've settled on the subject of our first episode. I'm going to work on scripting it this week, but keep the Who of it a surprise. Anyone interested in lending their creative expertise to editing or writing should feel free to reach out to me, though this would spoil said surprise.
